{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify completed orders with invalid (NaN) revenue
invalid_revenue_completed = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue'].isna())]

# Check what the revenue values were before conversion (they were strings)
invalid_revenue_completed[['order_id', 'revenue', 'status']]"}
